rounds.prompt: The film was shorter than I had expected.
rounds.stem: The film ___ I had expected.
rounds.note: not as long as = shorter than.

rounds.prompt: 'The price of the tickets has risen by over 10%,' said Joana.
rounds.stem: Joana said that the price of the tickets ___ than 10%.
rounds.note: reported speech: past perfect; go up by more than = rise by over.

rounds.prompt: She plays the guitar in the band and sings as well.
rounds.stem: Not ___ the guitar in the band, she also sings.
rounds.note: Not only + inversion: Not only does she play …

rounds.prompt: My dad thought it would be good for me to study abroad for a year.
rounds.stem: My dad thought that I would ___ abroad for a year.
rounds.note: benefit from + -ing.

rounds.prompt: I'm sorry I didn't contact you, but my phone was broken.
rounds.stem: I apologise for ___ you, but my phone was broken.
rounds.note: apologise for (not) + -ing; get in touch with.

rounds.prompt: Max was so tired that he went to bed in his trainers.
rounds.stem: Max was so tired that he did not even ___.
rounds.note: take something off: the object goes between.

rounds.prompt: It was Nuno's job to book the bus for the school trip.
rounds.stem: Nuno ___ the bus for the school trip.
rounds.note: be responsible for + -ing.

rounds.prompt: I had expected to enjoy the concert more than I did.
rounds.stem: The concert was ___ I had expected.
rounds.note: not as … as = less than expected.

rounds.prompt: Leonor finally managed to think of an idea for her video.
rounds.stem: Leonor finally succeeded ___ an idea for her video.
rounds.note: succeed in + -ing; come up with = think of.

rounds.prompt: My brother regrets selling his old bike.
rounds.stem: My brother ___ his old bike.
rounds.note: wish + past perfect: a regret about the past.

rounds.prompt: I was late for school because I missed the bus.
rounds.stem: I was late for school ___ the bus.
rounds.note: on account of + -ing = because of.
